summary.text: Kris Valderrama is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 26, where she has served since January 10, 2007, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Valderrama earned a bachelor's degree from Salisbury State University in 1996.
Her professional experience includes working as anchor and co-host of Valderrama's America.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as the Economic Matters Committee and the Rules & Executive Nominations Committee.
